about_the_game:
Tippy’s Quest is a top-down action RPG that combines classic open-world exploration, RPG progression, and endless-wave combat. The game's core loop is to battle through monster-filled worlds, collect powerful gear, and develop your character.

Players begin their journey at The Dragon’s Roost, an inn where they can manage inventory, access storage, modify/upgrade equipment, and visit vendors. From the inn, players can travel out the front door to the Outlands, an open-world region filled with roaming enemies and hidden secrets, or use Dimensional Portals to enter survival maps that challenge the player to endure against endless waves of enemies while exploring the dimensional realm.

Slain enemies can reward gold, items, and experience. These resources feed into systems of progression that encourage experimentation. Mix and match skills, skill builds, and equipment to push your character’s limits through risk-and-reward gameplay that is designed for both solo and multiplayer play.

Key Features

  • Action-RPG Combat: Engage in battles with magic, melee, and ranged skills.

  • Character Progression: Level up to unlock and enhance skills, stats, and disciplines.

  • Loot and Equipment: Acquire weapons, armor, and items of varying rarity and stats.

  • Inn: Manage gear, interact with vendors, and access other worlds.

  • Tippy Shrine: Use the shrine to upgrade gear or offer items to gain permanent bonuses.

  • The Outlands: Explore an open-world environment with enemies, secrets, and locked areas.

  • Dimensional Portals: Enter wave-based survival maps with increasing difficulty and escalating rewards.

  • Multiplayer: Join friends and experience the game together.

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti or AMD R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
